title: Set up a project
story: You're starting a new design campaign against {{target}}. Make a project folder called {{target}}_design in your home folder, with three folders inside it: inputs, outputs and scripts.

tasks.text: Inside it, make inputs, outputs and scripts

hints: `mkdir NAME` makes a folder. You can give it several names at once.
Run `mkdir {{target}}_design`, `cd {{target}}_design`, then `mkdir inputs outputs scripts`. Check with `ls`.
